fight_rounds_score_range.name: fight_rounds_score_range
fight_rounds_score_range.value: ("fight_rounds"."fighter_a_score" IS NULL OR "fight_rounds"."fighter_a_score" BETWEEN 6 AND 10) AND ("fight_rounds"."fighter_b_score" IS NULL OR "fight_rounds"."fighter_b_score" BETWEEN 6 AND 10)

live_round_scores_valid_combination.name: live_round_scores_valid_combination
live_round_scores_valid_combination.value:
(
        ("live_round_scores"."fighter_a_score" = 10 AND "live_round_scores"."fighter_b_score" BETWEEN 8 AND 9) OR
        ("live_round_scores"."fighter_a_score" BETWEEN 8 AND 9 AND "live_round_scores"."fighter_b_score" = 10) OR
        ("live_round_scores"."fighter_a_score" = 10 AND "live_round_scores"."fighter_b_score" = 10) OR
        ("live_round_scores"."fighter_a_score" = 9 AND "live_round_scores"."fighter_b_score" = 9) OR
        ("live_round_scores"."fighter_a_score" = 10 AND "live_round_scores"."fighter_b_score" = 7) OR
        ("live_round_scores"."fighter_a_score" = 7 AND "live_round_scores"."fighter_b_score" = 10)
      )

polls_window_order.name: polls_window_order
polls_window_order.value: "polls"."opens_at" IS NULL OR "polls"."closes_at" IS NULL OR "polls"."closes_at" > "polls"."opens_at"

polls_exactly_one_target.name: polls_exactly_one_target
polls_exactly_one_target.value: ((CASE WHEN "polls"."event_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) + (CASE WHEN "polls"."fight_id" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)) = 1

predictions_resolved_has_correct.name: predictions_resolved_has_correct
predictions_resolved_has_correct.value: "predictions"."resolved_at" IS NULL OR "predictions"."is_correct" IS NOT NULL
